items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’m jumping quite a bit forward now, to 1989. There’s an interesting Tom Harrell record that I heard a long time ago, called Sail Away. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, his record. Record date, Bill Goodwin? Bill Goodwin production, I believe?

ctx.x: and acoustic, and I want to change the music around.” That’s how that date came out. That’s a good record. A lot of thought went in that. I wanted to come up with my own way of doing Trane.
